comparison.objective: Insert an oil-feed sleeve while registering radial ports; candidate inserts and snaps a collet into a nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial axial insertion while preserving angular port registration versus marked eccentric groove entry followed by tilt-and-roll snap capture.
comparison.success_condition: Sleeve fully seated, released, stable, and oil passage unobstructed versus collet circumferentially retained and withdrawal-resistant.
comparison.reason: Both are precision assembly, but the sleeve tests functional radial registration and axial seating; the candidate tests eccentric snap retention. Candidate geometry/force limits are missing.
